status: Source-backed implemented journal reference; not independently gameplay-verified
notes: All 30 Sora farm targets have a suggested world/room, encounter entry, finish condition, retry path and fallback. These are source-backed routes, not guaranteed drops or a complete spawn database. All 30 rates match the original remake Ultimania tables; Steam probabilities have not been measured or extracted.

records.worldsSourceText: Traverse Town, Wonderland, Olympus Coliseum, Agrabah, Monstro, Halloween Town, Atlantica (Bottomless Darkness only), Neverland, Hollow Bastion, Twilight Town, Destiny Islands, Castle Oblivion
records.selectionRule: Target must be the final enemy defeated for the battle-end enemy-card roll.
records.verification: Published remake rate corroborated against Final Mix+ Ultimania, p. 367, and the edition-selected wiki. Not measured or extracted from a Steam executable.

farmRoute.encounter: Look for the lower left Shadow encounter; check the battle for Shadow.
farmRoute.finish: Defeat other species first, then finish with Shadow as the final enemy. Avoid a mixed-species finishing sleight when its kill order is uncertain.
farmRoute.retry: Save next door before the attempt. Save again after receiving the card. If it does not drop, reload that earlier save or continue to another encounter. If reloading repeats the same outcome, change the battle sequence or try a fresh room.
farmRoute.fallback: For ordinary grinding, try Teeming Darkness, Almighty Darkness or Looming Darkness in Halloween Town; inspect battles for Shadow and defeat it last. Clear a target-free battle and try another; synthesize a fresh room when exhausted.
farmRoute.evidence: Suggested manual-combat route using a published encounter location; battle composition and drops can vary. Exact RNG recipes are optional and separate.

rngRoute.encounter: Strike the barrels: break the rear barrel, then the two left barrels together.

rngRoute.caveat: Community route transcribed from DERIKUF; Steam players report success with the video methods, not a guaranteed per-route outcome. Retry from the save after failure.

guidance.title: Barrel encounters
guidance.text: Save while the barrels are intact. Leaving and re-entering a room does not restore broken barrels in Re:CoM; reload the earlier save or synthesize a fresh room. Defeat the Spider before it self-destructs, which gives no card prize.

farmRoute.encounter: Break intact barrels to enter a Barrel Spider battle.
farmRoute.finish: Leave a Barrel Spider for last, then defeat it before self-destruction. An explosion does not award its card.
farmRoute.retry: Save with the barrels intact before trying. After failure, reload that save or synthesize a fresh room; walking out and back does not restore broken barrels. Save after receiving the card.
farmRoute.fallback: Use fresh barrel-bearing rooms in Monstro, Olympus Coliseum or Agrabah. Preserve a save before breaking props; inspect the resulting battle and defeat a Spider last.
farmRoute.evidence: Suggested manual-combat route using a published encounter location; battle composition and drops can vary. Exact RNG recipes are optional and separate.

repeatRoute.instructions: Create a save room next to the farming room and save before the attempt. Defeat the target last. If no card drops, return to the title screen and reload that save before retrying. Save successful drops before continuing.
